Rows that already exist change nothing. Row messages: "invalid email", "membership is not active", "domain not allowed", "displayName must be at most 100 characters".

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Deletes its scores too; final grades do not change.

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. Upserts 1 to 500 scores in one transaction: any bad row fails the request. Errors: scores (count), scores[<i>].userId ("must be a uuid", "duplicate userId", "is not enrolled in this section"), scores[<i>].points ("is required", "must be a number", "must have at most 2 decimals", "must be between 0 and <2 x maxPoints>"); points null deletes that score (no error when there was none). Final grades never change. Returns every score of the assessment.

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email, points. Max 5 MiB. Rows: add (no score yet), update (score changes; message "<old> → <new>"), exists (same score), error. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "invalid email", "unknown email", "not enrolled in this section", "points is required", "points must be a number", "points must have at most 2 decimals", "points must be between 0 and <2 x maxPoints>", "duplicate of line <n>".

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email, points. Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "invalid email", "unknown email", "not enrolled in this section", "points is required", "points must be a number", "points must have at most 2 decimals", "points must be between 0 and <2 x maxPoints>", "duplicate of line <n>".

With Accept: text/csv the response is text/csv; charset=utf-8 (UTF-8 BOM, attachment gradebook.csv): header email, displayName, one column per assessment name (by position), percent, letter, final; one row per student; empty cell when absent; final is the final letter, or incomplete / withdrawn, or empty.

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Gives every enrolled student a final grade: weights must sum to 100.00 (else field weights), every assessment becomes published, a missing score counts as 0, the letter comes from the unrounded percent, percent is stored rounded half up to 2 decimals. Overrides apply in the same transaction (fields overrides[<i>].userId, .status, .letter, .reason). 409 when the section is already finalized (reopen first). Body may be {}.
Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Deletes every final grade of the section; assessments stay published. 404 when it has none.

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. reason is required. letter must be on the scale and needs status graded; points follow the scale row. Switching incomplete or withdrawn back to graded recomputes percent from the current scores (missing = 0) and, without letter, its letter. Body with only reason is 400 field "" ("no fields to update"); an unchanged letter keeps its recorded points.

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required courseCode, termName, number; optional instructorEmails, taEmails (semicolon-separated), meetings (semicolon-separated slots "Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101"; weekday Mon..Sun, case-insensitive; 24-hour HH:MM; "@ location" optional). Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "number is required", "number must be at most 20 characters", "unknown course code <X>", "unknown term <X>", "course <X> is not in a department you manage", "invalid email <raw>", "<email> listed as both instructor and ta", "<email>: membership is not active", "meeting \"<slot>\" must look like Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101", "meeting \"<slot>\": unknown weekday <X>", "meeting \"<slot>\": <field> <message>", "at most 20 meetings". An existing section is never changed; instructors, TAs and invitations missing from it are added (action add/invite, message "section exists; adds staff"); listed staff keep their current role. Meetings are written for a new section, or an existing one that has none (message "section exists; adds meetings"); an existing section's meetings are never changed (message "section exists; keeps meetings").
